headline: OpenAI enhances GPT-5.6 with new features and extends access.

items.title: Improving GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT—and expanding access to GPT-5.6 Luna for free users
items.summary: OpenAI has released improvements to GPT-5.6 Sol in ChatGPT, which now boasts enhanced accuracy and consistency. Additionally, they are expanding access to GPT-5.6 Luna for free users, allowing unlimited everyday chats. This move is expected to democratize access to advanced AI capabilities, providing more users with high-quality conversational AI.
items.why_it_matters: This update is crucial for developers as it increases the accessibility of advanced AI models, enabling more innovative applications and wider testing of AI systems.

items.title: A guide to slash commands in the GitHub Copilot app
items.summary: GitHub has introduced new slash commands in the Copilot app to enhance developer workflows. These commands facilitate planning, collaboration, automation, and customization, making it easier for developers to integrate AI into their coding processes seamlessly.

items.title: LLM optimization integration for Amazon SageMaker Python SDK
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker Python SDK v3 now includes generative AI inference recommendations directly in your notebook. This integration allows developers to benchmark an endpoint, generate deployment recommendations, and implement the suggested configurations within their workflow, enhancing efficiency and performance of AI applications.

items.title: Oracle bans AI-generated code from OpenJDK
items.summary: Oracle has announced a ban on AI-generated code from being included in OpenJDK. This decision is part of a broader effort to ensure code quality and reliability, as AI-generated code can sometimes introduce unforeseen errors or inconsistencies.

items.title: WeatherNext: AI model achieves breakthrough in forecasting cyclones
items.summary: Google DeepMind's WeatherNext model has achieved a significant breakthrough in forecasting cyclones. By leveraging advanced machine learning techniques, the model improves prediction accuracy, which could have substantial impacts on disaster preparedness and response strategies globally.

How Cohere Health digitizes clinical policies using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
all_items.summary: In this post, you learn how Cohere Health built a multi-tenant agentic architecture on AgentCore using AgentCore Runtime’s secure MicroVM isolation, unified tool access through AgentCore Gateway, AgentCore Memory, and the Agent Skills open standard to rapidly scale policy digitization capabilities, while preserving transparency, version control, and human oversight.

all_items.title: How TReNDS automates root-cause analysis with Amazon Bedrock
all_items.summary: TReNDS, a research center at Georgia State University, built an agentic AI pipeline on Amazon Bedrock and the open-source Strands Agents SDK that automatically investigates production errors in real time, reducing root-cause analysis from 15 to 30 minutes of manual work to under 60 seconds.

all_items.title: Determining playoff clinching scenarios in the NHL using constraint programming
all_items.summary: The AWS Generative AI Innovation Center built an automated system that uses constraint programming and custom tree search to determine, with mathematical certainty, when and how an NHL team clinches a playoff spot. The approach was validated against four full NHL seasons of officially published results.

all_items.title: Securing AI agents with temporal policies in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
all_items.summary: Temporal policies in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore let you define stateful rules that evaluate authorization based on an agent's session history. Learn how to enforce workflow sequencing, prevent data fabrication, cap financial exposure, and require human approval for high-value actions.

all_items.title: Configure rate limits for AI traffic on AgentCore gateway
all_items.summary: Learn how to configure rate limits on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gateway to enforce per-user and per-target traffic controls. Define request, token, and connection limits scoped by JWT claims or IAM identity to protect downstream models, tools, and agents from traffic spikes.

all_items.title: Control agent behaviors and cost beyond a single action: new capabilities in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
all_items.summary: Learn about new capabilities in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: temporal policies powered by Dogwood, a new open source policy language for AI agents, and rate limiting on the gateway. These features give you deterministic control over sequences of agent actions and cost ceilings that hold regardless of agent behavior.

all_items.title: Build visibility for Codex on Amazon Bedrock with OpenTelemetry and Amazon CloudWatch
all_items.summary: As engineering teams adopt coding agents like Codex, leaders need visibility into adoption, consumption, and reliability. This post shows how to route Codex OpenTelemetry metrics through a local collector to Amazon CloudWatch for an AWS native view of usage by user, team, and cost center.

all_items.title: Agent Skills for Automated Reasoning policies in Amazon Bedrock
all_items.summary: Learn how to run the full Amazon Bedrock Automated Reasoning policy lifecycle from your coding agent. A suite of open source Agent Skills builds, reviews, tests, debugs, deploys, and validates a custom policy end to end, turning a specialized console task into a repeatable engineering workflow.

all_items.title: Building an agentic app deployer with Amazon Bedrock and AWS Lambda
all_items.summary: PDI Technologies built PDI Brew, an agentic platform on AWS where non-technical employees describe a tool in plain English and receive a fully provisioned, multi-tenant web application in seconds. See how a pluggable planner and an AWS Lambda provisioning agent turn plain-English intent into governed, multi-tenant apps backed by Amazon Bedrock.
